get_mean_and_std: compute the mean and standard deviation of a PyTorch dataset for normalization
init_params: initialize network layer parameters using Kaiming normal for Conv2d and small normal for Linear
progress_bar: display a terminal progress bar with step time, total time, and optional message
format_time: format a number of seconds into a compact human-readable time string with days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
review_utils: review the PyTorch utility functions for dataset statistics, parameter initialization, progress display, and time formatting
